name: CurveBeam AI Limited
summary: CurveBeam AI Limited develops and makes point-of-care weight-bearing medical imaging equipment for Europe, North America and other markets. Its products include HiRise bilateral weight-bearing CT, LineUP for knees and lower extremities, pedCAT and pedCAT Premium for foot and ankle, InReach extremity CT and CubeVue visualisation software, plus AI software such as Autometrics for segmenting foot and ankle datasets.
